# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Eight years old  <sub>[v2 c27 P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004), [v3 c1 P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v3 c1 P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Welby  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Second-primer schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001)</sub>; Robin-boy  <sub>[v3 c1 P34](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0034), [v3 c28 P2](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is a fair-haired, attractive young boy with a round skull covered in a head of tiny, fuzzy yellow ringlets. He has a snubbed nose, a perpetually smiling mouth, and a single dimple in one cheek that indents when he chuckles. His face expresses joy, playfulness, and elfish roguishness. As he gets older, he grows visibly taller.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c20 P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), [v2 c25 P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071), [v3 c28 P0](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0000), [v3 c40 P5](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0005)_

## Personality

Robin is an enthusiastic, good-humoured, and highly energetic boy with a mischievous nature. Extremely inquisitive and curious about the world, he frequently poses puzzling questions to his guardians. Though prone to forgetfulness, carelessness, and pulling dreadful faces, he possesses a natural gift for capturing affection and is easily comforted.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c9 P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c19 P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c25 P41](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0041)_

## History

Robin grew up in East Welby alongside his twin sister, Lucy, until their mother passed away. His third cousin once removed, Thirza Abernethy, took the twins into her home at Grey Shutters. Upon his arrival, Robin proved to be a handful of restless energy and constant mischief, quickly forming a deep attachment to Nell Harcourt. He began attending school, sitting alongside his friend Milty Gammon and taking part in games with his peers. Over time, his behavior settled down, and he developed a passion for agriculture, eventually seeking permission from Thirza to take over managing the farm in the coming year.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c21 P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)_
